cases.name: P0-canonical
cases.reason: canonical signature-positive payload in a single TCP segment

cases.name: P1-boundary-segments
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload split at parser and required-content boundaries

cases.name: P2-many-small-segments
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload split into many small TCP segments

cases.name: P3-retransmission
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload with one byte-identical retransmitted data segment

cases.name: P4-lowercase-uri
cases.reason: signature-positive install endpoint replayed in lower case, which nocase accepts

cases.name: P5-lowercase-csrf-header
cases.reason: signature-positive CSRF header name replayed in lower case, which nocase accepts

cases.name: P6-uppercase-ipaddress-key
cases.reason: signature-positive JSON key replayed in upper case, which nocase accepts

cases.name: N-wrong-method
cases.reason: GET replaces the required POST method

cases.name: N-uri-endpoint-changed
cases.reason: URI stops short of the install endpoint literal

cases.name: N-uri-not-at-start
cases.reason: endpoint literal is present but preceded by a proxy path

cases.name: N-cookie-name-changed
cases.reason: request carries a different session cookie name

cases.name: N-cookie-not-at-start
cases.reason: authentication cookie is present but not first in http.cookie

cases.name: N-csrf-header-absent
cases.reason: request omits the CSRF token header name

cases.name: N-body-json-key-changed
cases.reason: body uses a different JSON key

cases.name: N-body-value-quote-absent
cases.reason: body value is unquoted, so the required quote never follows the key

cases.name: N-body-value-quote-beyond-within
cases.reason: quote appears more than 5 bytes after the JSON key

cases.name: N-body-first-separator-beyond-within
cases.reason: first separator appears more than 5 bytes after the opening quote

cases.name: N-body-second-separator-beyond-within
cases.reason: second separator appears more than 5 bytes after the first

cases.name: N-body-third-separator-absent
cases.reason: address carries only two separators instead of the required three

cases.name: N-body-third-separator-beyond-within
cases.reason: third separator appears more than 5 bytes after the second

cases.name: N-body-no-injection-metacharacter
cases.reason: address value ends with a benign assignment instead of an injectable metacharacter

cases.name: N-body-metacharacter-beyond-pcre-bound
cases.reason: injectable metacharacter appears past the PCRE's five-byte bound

cases.name: N-flow-not-established
cases.reason: canonical payload is sent without a completed TCP handshake

cases.name: N-wrong-direction
cases.reason: canonical payload is replayed to client; request buffers stay empty in the response direction

cases.name: N-wrong-destination-address
cases.reason: canonical payload is sent to a server outside the monitored network

cases.name: N-random-http-request
cases.reason: protocol-valid HTTP request that satisfies no combination of rule predicates
